title: Broken ankle
wikitext:
Gameplay feature introduced in [[Kombat Teams]].

In QuakeWorld when your landing speed is less then -650 (happens if you land from a high place), "hard land" sound is played and you also receive 5 damage points. 

What wasn't present in original QuakeWorld and what [[Kombat Teams]] mod added was a behavior which made it close to impossible to continue [[Bunny Hopping|bunny hopping]] in case of falling from a high place.

Later mods added [[Fallbunny]] setting which allowed to disable this new behavior.
